local function SpawnCube()
    local cube = Instance.new("Frame")
    local size = math.random(8, 16)
    cube.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
    
    local startX = math.random(2, 95) / 100
    cube.Position = UDim2.new(startX, 0, -0.08, 0)
    
    if math.random(1, 2) == 1 then
        cube.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
    else
        cube.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 140, 0)
    end
    
    cube.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
    cube.ZIndex = 1
    cube.Parent = ParticleContainer

    local cubeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", cube)
    cubeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)

    local duration = math.random(4, 7)
    local targetY = UDim2.new(startX, 0, 1.1, 0)
    
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(cube, tweenInfo, {
        Position = targetY,
        Rotation = math.random(-180, 180),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.95
    })

    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        cube:Destroy()
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if MainFrame.Visible then
            SpawnCube()
        end
        task.wait(0.4)
    end
end)

local function AddTargetCard(targetPlayerObj)
    local pName = targetPlayerObj.Name

    local CardFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

    CardStroke.Thickness = 1

    AvatarImg.ZIndex = 4
    AvatarImg.Parent = CardFrame

    local ImgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", AvatarImg)
    ImgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local NameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    NameLabel.ZIndex = 4
    NameLabel.Parent = CardFrame

    local StatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    StatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 0.5)

    StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    StatusLabel.TextSize = 11
    StatusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    StatusLabel.ZIndex = 4
    StatusLabel.Parent = CardFrame

    local SamlatTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    SamlatTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0)
    SamlatTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0.18, 0, 0.3)
    SamlatTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    SamlatTitle.Text = "صملة:"
    SamlatTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
    SamlatTitle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    SamlatTitle.TextSize = 12
    SamlatTitle.ZIndex = 4
    SamlatTitle.Parent = CardFrame

    local SamlatTimer = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    SamlatTimer.Position = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 0.42, 0)
    SamlatTimer.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.45)
    SamlatTimer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    SamlatTimer.Text = "00:00:00"
    SamlatTimer.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
    SamlatTimer.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    SamlatTimer.TextSize = 12
    SamlatTimer.ZIndex = 4
    SamlatTimer.Parent = CardFrame

    local SpectateBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    SpectateBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
    SpectateBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.3, 0)
    SpectateBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 0, 180)
    SpectateBtn.Text = "👁"
    SpectateBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    SpectateBtn.TextSize = 11
    SpectateBtn.ZIndex = 4
    SpectateBtn.Parent = CardFrame

    local SpecCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", SpectateBtn)
    SpecCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local CopyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    CopyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
    CopyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.3, 0)
    CopyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 60, 150)
    CopyBtn.Text = "📋"
    CopyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    CopyBtn.TextSize = 11
    CopyBtn.ZIndex = 4
    CopyBtn.Parent = CardFrame

    local CopyCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", CopyBtn)
    CopyCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local DeleteBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    DeleteBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
    DeleteBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.3, 0)
    DeleteBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)
    DeleteBtn.Text = "X"
    DeleteBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    DeleteBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    DeleteBtn.TextSize = 11
    DeleteBtn.ZIndex = 4
    DeleteBtn.Parent = CardFrame

    local DelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", DeleteBtn)
    DelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local StartTime = os.time()
    local Leaves, Joins = 0, 0

    Tracked[pName:lower()] = {
        OnLeave = function()
            Leaves = Leaves + 1
            StatusLabel.Text = "الخروج: " .. Leaves .. "\nالدخول: " .. Joins
        end,
        OnJoin = function()
            Joins = Joins + 1
            StatusLabel.Text = "الخروج: " .. Leaves .. "\nالدخول: " .. Joins
        end
    }

    task.spawn(function()
        while CardFrame.Parent do
            local diff = os.time() - StartTime
            local h = string.format("%02d", math.floor(diff / 3600))
            local m = string.format("%02d", math.floor((diff % 3600) / 60))
            local s = string.format("%02d", diff % 60)
            SamlatTimer.Text = h .. ":" .. m .. ":" .. s
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    local isSpectating = false
    SpectateBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
        if isSpectating then
            isSpectating = false
            SpectateBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 0, 180)
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                Camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
            end
        else
            if targetPlr and targetPlr.Character and targetPlr.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                isSpectating = true
                SpectateBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 50)
                Camera.CameraSubject = targetPlr.Character.Humanoid
            end
        end
    end)

    CopyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local info = string.format("اسم اللاعب: %s | صملة: %s | الخروج: %d | الدخول: %d", pName, SamlatTimer.Text, Leaves, Joins)
        setclipboard(info)
    end)

    DeleteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if isSpectating and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            Camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
        end
        Tracked[pName:lower()] = nil
        CardFrame:Destroy()
    end)
end

AddBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local text = InputBox.Text
    if #text < 1 then return end

    local foundPlayer = nil
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and (string.sub(p.Name:lower(), 1, #text) == text:lower() or string.sub(p.DisplayName:lower(), 1, #text) == text:lower()) then
            foundPlayer = p
            break
        end
    end

    if foundPlayer then
        if not Tracked[foundPlayer.Name:lower()] then
            AddTargetCard(foundPlayer)
        end
    else
        InputBox.Text = ""
        InputBox.PlaceholderText = "اللاعب غير موجود!"
        task.wait(1.5)
        InputBox.PlaceholderText = "اكتب اسم اللاعب..."
        return
    end
    InputBox.Text = ""
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local data = Tracked[player.Name:lower()]
    if data then
        data.OnLeave()
    end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local data = Tracked[player.Name:lower()]
    if data then
        data.OnJoin()
    end
end)
